entities.name: UniProt A4G7T5
observations: Exact full-length sequence match (243 aa; 100% identity and coverage) to reviewed Herminiimonas arsenicoxydans leucyl/phenylalanyl-tRNA–protein transferase.
Annotated function: transfers Leu and Phe, and less efficiently Met, from aminoacyl-tRNAs to protein N-termini, consistent with the bacterial N-end rule pathway; EC 2.3.2.6.
Reference annotation places the protein in the cytoplasm; GO annotations include transferase activity and protein catabolic process.
Sequence-derived estimates: molecular mass 27.03 kDa, pI 5.20, instability index 27.64, GRAVY 0.053; estimates assume unmodified sequence.
